title: Learning to summarize with human feedback
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: We’ve applied reinforcement learning from human feedback to train language models that are better at summarization....
body:
We’ve applied reinforcement learning from human feedback to train language models that are better at summarization.
